description: The case's dirty/ folder leaves notes.txt uncommitted, outside the feature's folder. The first implement-task subagent (T-1.2) replies with its uncommitted-changes stop line. build-phase ends the run with that line, word for word, and does not retry it, run T-1.3, or verify.

must_match.why: a stop line from a subagent ends the run
implement-task stops before it switches branch

must_match.pattern: ^Stopped: Uncommitted changes in notes\.txt\. Commit or stash them, then run implement-task again\.$
must_match.why: implement-task's stop line, copied word for word
the first build task ran in a subagent

must_not_match.why: a stop line is never retried, and no later task runs
verify-spec does not run after a stop
nothing is committed and the uncommitted file is left alone
it never pushes, merges, or rewrites history

manual: notes.txt is still there and uncommitted; git log has only the initial commit.
